summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration 5 fixes, run in the Expo web preview at 375x667 with Playwright across 7 sessions. All requested fixes work. (1) Delete-task fix: the Creator submitted d1 (approvals went from 3 to 4), then Super Admin deleted t9. The count stayed at 4, approval-draft-row-d1 still appears in the Approvals module with '· Recently', and opening and approving it works (it then leaves the list). (2) Blocked empty submit: from Preview mode, a cleared d1 shows the toast 'Add a title or body first', switches to the Write tab, shows the field error, and stays in Draft. (3) Copy grammar: 72 generations (image ad, ad script and product description x 8 tones x 3 variations) had no 'a' before a vowel, no 'a a', no 'rupee' or 'magic care' phrasing, and no '<Opener>: <topic>?' hooks. (4) Regression passes: generate (toast), save (Draft, toast), Preview renders, copy (toast), delete with confirm; Creator submit locks the editor; Owner/Admin approval sets d1 to Approved and t9 to Approved, adds an asset to c1 (2 to 3) and drops approvals from 4 to 3; Publisher gets no-access on /studio/content and /studio/editor and has no studio entry points. No page errors. One remaining edge-case bug, same type as last time: deleting campaign c1 while d1 is In review drops d1 from approvals. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

integration_issues.flow: Delete a campaign whose task has a linked In review draft
integration_issues.issue: Repro: the Creator submits d1 (approvals = 4), then Super Admin deletes campaign c1. Approvals goes to 2, but 3 was expected, because only the c1 task 'Gift guide article: 10 picks' should drop. d1 is still 'In review' in the studio but no longer appears in approvals. Cause: deleteCampaign (DataStore.tsx:133-144) removes the campaign's tasks but does not clear drafts[].taskId or cid, and pendingDraftApprovals (dashboard.ts:48) skips any draft that has a taskId.

issues: Double punctuation when the tone opener ends with ':' or '—'. Product: 'Crafted for those who notice: the Herbal Care festive range: a luxurious essential…' (also Warm 'Made with care: … : a gentle essential'). Image ad: 'Psst — the Herbal Care festive range — natural ingredients…'.
'an easy essential for natural ingredients' and 'Each detail is proven' read a little oddly. Low priority.
The card still says 'Planned for a later phase · preview only' even though draft approvals work from here.
The error toast 'Add a title or body first' uses the same checkmark (success) icon as success toasts. Consider a warning icon.

action_items: In deleteCampaign (DataStore.tsx:133), also map drafts so that any draft whose taskId belongs to a deleted task, or whose cid === id, gets taskId: null (and cid: null). Alternatively, make pendingDraftApprovals treat a draft as unlinked when its task no longer exists.
Optional copy polish: avoid a double ':' or '—' when the tone opener already ends in ':' or '—' (product line 73 and image ad base line 138 in generator.ts).
Optional: update the Approvals 'preview only' text, and use a warning icon for error toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: pendingApprovals (tasks) is not filtered for the publisher role: Publisher Home shows '3 To review'. pendingDraftApprovals returns [] for publisher, so the two are inconsistent.
Neither approvals function filters by visibleCampaigns, so items from private campaigns could count for managers who cannot see those campaigns.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested fixes and regression checks; 1 new related edge-case bug (deleteCampaign)

seed_data_creation: None. Data is in-memory and each session starts fresh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Role ids: super_admin, admin (Owner/Admin), editor (Creator), publisher. Exec helpers with exec(open('/app/tests/ui/helpers.py').read(), globals()). A draft linked to a task shows in Approvals as approval-row-<taskId>; an unlinked draft shows as approval-draft-row-<id>. The Approvals module uses placeholder-back-button, so helpers.tab() cannot back out of it. To reach a route without reloading: history.pushState plus a popstate event. Seed state: approvals = 3, c1 has 2 assets.
rca_of_issue: deleteTask now nulls drafts' taskId (fixed). deleteCampaign removes tasks with cid === id but has no equivalent drafts mapping, so a draft linked to one of those tasks keeps a dangling taskId and is filtered out by pendingDraftApprovals (!d.taskId).
